# cdnpro_client_regions (Data Source)

Lists client region codes for `cdnpro_edge_hostname.client_zones[].region`. Results are sorted by `code`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cdnpro_client_regions" "all" {}
data "cdnpro_isps" "all" {}

locals {
  us_region_code = [for r in data.cdnpro_client_regions.all.regions : r.code if r.name == "United States"][0]
  att_isp_code   = [for i in data.cdnpro_isps.all.isps : i.code if i.name == "ATT"][0]
}

resource "cdnpro_edge_hostname" "main" {
  edge_hostname = "example.edgesuffix.qtlgslb.com"

  client_zones = [
    {
      region = local.us_region_code
      isp    = local.att_isp_code
      action = { type = "deliver", by = ["premium"] }
    },
    {
      region = "all"
      isp    = "all"
      action = { type = "deliver", by = ["standard"] }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `isp_code` (String) Only regions where this ISP (a `cdnpro_isps` code) operates.
- `search` (String) Substring match on code or name.

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Matching client regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `name` (String)
